mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ATCH_FILE_INFO ( ATCH_FILE_MNG_NO, FILE_SEQ, ORGNL_FILE_NM, STRG_FILE_NM, ATCH_FILE_PATH_NM, FILE_SZ, FILE_EXTN_NM, FILE_TYPE_NM, REG_DT ) VALUES ( #{atchFileMngNo}, #{fileSeq}, #{orgnlFileNm}, #{strgFileNm}, #{atchFilePathNm}, #{fileSz}, #{fileExtnNm}, #{fileTypeNm}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT ATCH_FILE_MNG_NO as atchFileMngNo, FILE_SEQ as fileSeq, ORGNL_FILE_NM as orgnlFileNm, STRG_FILE_NM as strgFileNm, ATCH_FILE_PATH_NM as atchFilePathNm, FILE_SZ as fileSz, FILE_EXTN_NM as fileExtnNm, FILE_TYPE_NM as fileTypeNm, REG_DT as regDt FROM ATCH_FILE_INFO WHERE ATCH_FILE_MNG_NO = #{atchFileMngNo} ORDER BY FILE_SEQ ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT ATCH_FILE_MNG_NO as atchFileMngNo, FILE_SEQ as fileSeq, ORGNL_FILE_NM as orgnlFileNm, STRG_FILE_NM as strgFileNm, ATCH_FILE_PATH_NM as atchFilePathNm, FILE_SZ as fileSz, FILE_EXTN_NM as fileExtnNm, FILE_TYPE_NM as fileTypeNm, REG_DT as regDt FROM ATCH_FILE_INFO WHERE ATCH_FILE_MNG_NO = #{atchFileMngNo} ORDER BY FILE_SEQ ASC

SELECT ATCH_FILE_MNG_NO as atchFileMngNo, FILE_SEQ as fileSeq, ORGNL_FILE_NM as orgnlFileNm, STRG_FILE_NM as strgFileNm, ATCH_FILE_PATH_NM as atchFilePathNm, FILE_SZ as fileSz, FILE_EXTN_NM as fileExtnNm, FILE_TYPE_NM as fileTypeNm, REG_DT as regDt FROM ATCH_FILE_INFO WHERE ATCH_FILE_MNG_NO = #{atchFileMngNo} AND FILE_SEQ = #{fileSeq} LIMIT 1
